configuration.extension_rule: Add frames 64 and 192 to the same 8 scenes only if fewer than 200 valid matched raw candidates in total or fewer than 4 scenes have >=20 valid raw candidates; independent of quality outcomes
configuration.primary_feasibility: not collision and not empty and 0 < mu <= 0.4
configuration.high_rank: rank<=50 in original fixed final pool; Top1 separately
configuration.B_evaluate: P0 all 1024 raw candidates; P1-P5 all valid matches; invalid targets remain unknown
configuration.reference: exact label point plus transformed label view frame and representative angle/depth/width, re-evaluated; P5 separately keeps prediction point and approach

AD_error_controlled.strata: scene/frame/object/exact nominal target score; wrong angle or depth versus both correct

P5.limitation: Nearest distance to exact 20k input points, including other objects; geometric support proxy, not proof of visibility or learnability

P5_aligned.limitation: Nearest distance to exact 20k input points, including other objects; geometric support proxy, not proof of visibility or learnability

R_labelpoint.limitation: Nearest distance to exact 20k input points, including other objects; geometric support proxy, not proof of visibility or learnability

supplementary.notes: Supplementary descriptive decomposition on frozen samples; physical-angle controls added after identifying basis mismatch, not substituted for pre-specified class-index primary. All-high-failure witness counts are verified lower bounds; invalid references remain unknown.

statistical_protocol: Scene-macro estimates; 10,000 stratified scene bootstrap resamples; C3 seen/similar/novel strata, training scene quartiles. Candidate totals descriptive only. Unknowns excluded, invalid references never labelled failures.

decision.core: EG 的代表性质量目标确实不直接重评最终预测姿态，且存在跨场景、可纠正的姿态—质量失配；但本轮尚不能把它与普通物理姿态误差及训练／推理坐标差异分离为独立的质量监督机制，结论为 HOLD。
decision.unique_gap: 在统一物理坐标、保持普通姿态监督与监督预算一致后，最终姿态质量对齐是否仍有额外作用。
decision.next_step: 停止扩大零训练诊断。若继续，只进行一次经授权的同预算最小对照，隔离“普通姿态监督／坐标一致性”与“最终姿态质量目标对齐”的增量；不增加重排序器或新模块。本轮没有启动该训练。

bounded_amendment: After finding class-index/physical-frame ambiguity, added P1_aligned/P4_aligned on the same fixed 8732 pairs, CPU only. P5_aligned was already evaluated as D3 control. Original class-index results retained; no threshold or sample changes.

resource_accounting.precision_note: Network inference retains TF32. Only read-only official label probe uses FP32 matrix multiplication; no prediction was changed.
resource_accounting.compute_note: Pose calls include duplicate controls; CPU time sums completed final evaluators only, excluding preflight/failed pilot/asset hashing. Inference receipt timing does not include all setup/reprobe overhead.

evidence_schema.C3_scope: Union of original final pools with and without CD; other raw candidates retained in prediction cache, quality unknown
evidence_schema.invalid_reference: valid_match=false; target and counterfactual numeric fields NaN; boolean witness flags false mean not established, not disproven
evidence_schema.mu: -1 is evaluated analytic failure, not missing; missing numeric field is unknown
evidence_schema.quality_utility: mean of pass(mu<=f) for f=.2,.4,.6,.8,1,1.2; collision/empty/noFC utility zero
evidence_schema.angle_periodicity: parallel-jaw pi symmetry; class-index mismatch is not physical roll mismatch
evidence_schema.physical_controls: P1_aligned/P4_aligned/P5_aligned preserve predicted center and approach, project transformed GT closing axis into prediction normal plane
evidence_schema.reference: R_labelpoint re-evaluates actual label center and full label rotation; R_predpoint changes approach but keeps predicted center; neither is counted as fixed-point/fixed-approach C recovery
evidence_schema.H1_witness: R_labelpoint feasible & P0 failed & specified P5 feasible; sufficient descriptive witness, not causal attribution
